sources.use_basis: Limited-domain working record: 30 wt% MEA on unloaded-solvent basis, 313.15–353.15 K (40–80 °C). 142 fitted targets: 48 pressure + 94 species (40 Böttinger + 54 Matin). Matin 18 HCO3− + CO3²− pool targets report-only; measurement 21 °C, packet 20 °C. SSM+DS narrow 4.6% local optimum advantage over Original Born; HCO3−–water k=+0.5 upper bound, no global optimum or uncertainty band. Poor 15/45 wt% transfer; carbonate comparison only retained nine points; 100–120 °C outside working qualification. R4 source range 293.15–323.15 K; inherited reaction-source extrapolation. No independent physical validation, caloric or process-column qualification. Two unavailable Born probe solves have undetermined cause under Engine investigation. Inherited pressure bounds are computational, not physically qualified. Historical 160-target SSM+DS: six attempted starts, five converged, one initial evaluation failed. 142-target P5 warm continuation: one further update, function tolerance 1e-12 relative, zero trial failures; not six independent starts. f66d972c S1 remains ancestry.

[composition]
basis = "analytical molar feed amounts"
units = "mol"
analytical_amines = ["methyldiethanolamine"]
loading_denominator = "mol analytical MDEA"
loading_units = "mol CO2 / mol MDEA"
pressure_units = "Pa"
temperature_units = "K"

# Atom counts and signed charge for the species in the four declared aqueous reactions.
[element_formulas]
water = {H = 2, O = 1, charge = 0}
carbon-dioxide = {C = 1, O = 2, charge = 0}
bicarbonate-anion = {H = 1, C = 1, O = 3, charge = -1}
carbonate-anion = {C = 1, O = 3, charge = -2}
hydronium-cation = {H = 3, O = 1, charge = 1}
hydroxide-anion = {H = 1, O = 1, charge = -1}
methyldiethanolamine = {C = 5, H = 13, N = 1, O = 2, charge = 0}
protonated-methyldiethanolamine = {C = 5, H = 14, N = 1, O = 2, charge = 1}

[export_conventions]
mass = "molar_mass is copied unchanged from the Engine parameter document, including rounded magnitudes, units and provenance. Formula masses for conservation are derived by the column; no Engine mass is altered."
caloric = "inputs/caloric.json is the single source of ideal-gas calorics. Ionic standard thermochemistry is completed by Engine from the four K(T) laws and the aqueous neutral reference; there is no independent reaction enthalpy or second absorption-heat source."
reaction_direction = "K is dimensionless; correlation is natural ln K: a and c dimensionless, b in K, d in 1/K, reference_temperature and temperature limits in K; reference_pressure_pa in Pa. Negative stoichiometric coefficients are reactants; positive coefficients are products. Extent unit: mol of reaction as written. Enthalpy follows the declared K(T) law and its source_basis/standard_state_id, with Engine reference conversion; it is not an independently fitted heat."
neutral_reference = "eq.NeutralReference fields: solvent (component ID), solute_molality_ratios (dimensionless), standard_molality_mol_per_kg (mol/kg solvent), species_reference (eq.SpeciesReference enum). No per-species override is declared (empty mapping); Engine uses PureLiquid for solvent and InfiniteDilution for every solute. Enum names: PureLiquid, InfiniteDilution, PureGas; no PureGas choice is used."
assessment = "Regions are prepared-row minima/maxima, not continuous validity domains. For saturation-capped heat observations, region records requested loading caps; evaluated_region records available native endpoint loadings from the retained results. wt_percent is unloaded aqueous analytical amine mass percent using unchanged Engine molar masses; loading is mol CO2/mol analytical MDEA. AARD_percent uses available nonzero observations only and is not experimental uncertainty. Phase search covers only the retained 751 endpoint states. Native observation values are retained by row; derivative actions were not assessed by #228."

[export_property_groups]
pressure = ["Kuranov", "Ermatchkov", "Kuranov-413K", "Sedighi", "Zheng", "corrected-Kamps"]
speciation = ["Jakobsen", "Bottinger-amine-sum-25bar", "Bottinger-amine-sum-5bar", "Bottinger-bicarbonate-25bar", "Bottinger-bicarbonate-5bar"]

Cp = ["Cp", "Cp-60wt"]
density = ["loaded-density", "unloaded-density", "density-60wt"]
binary_VLE = ["Kim"]

# Analytical mole incidence, consistent with the declared formulas and reaction extents.
[analytical_components]
water = {water = 1}
carbon-dioxide = {carbon-dioxide = 1}
methyldiethanolamine = {methyldiethanolamine = 1}
protonated-methyldiethanolamine = {methyldiethanolamine = 1}
